title: MudGym Playground
content_html:
Below is MUD2, one of the earliest online multiplayer games, compiled to WebAssembly and running in your browser tab. Much of the original C engine code, some of it dating back to the early 90s, is unchanged. I built these examples alongside MudGym, a reinforcement learning environment built around the game. Most of them are marimo notebooks, running MudGym itself in Python in your browser through Pyodide.
